'''Scout Services''' was an organization of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] whose duty was the exploration of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was a subdivision of the [[Resources Division]] that sent [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] to investigate and scan unexplored [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] within the CSA sphere of influence. All information logged by Scout Services was passed on to the [[Feasibility]] subdivision.<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
